story: Sophie is in the garden. Sophie has a red crown and big sparkly wings. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is a fairy princess today! Sophie finds a small brown rabbit under the rose bush. [emotion:QT/surprised] The rabbit is sitting on Sophie's magic wand! [emotion:QT/afraid] Sophie cannot reach the wand. Sophie's friend Mia is in the garden too. Mia picks up the rabbit very gently. Sophie takes the wand. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Mia are jumping and laughing together. [gesture:clapping] Sophie puts the crown on Mia's head. [gesture:emotions/hoora] The two friends are dancing in the garden. [emotion:QT/happy]
